notes: Prose page (macrobiotic yin-yang), no two-column table, so no structural row headers appeared under both directions. Emphasis markup puts 陰性食品/陽性食品/極陽性/陽性 on their own lines (19,21,23,26,32,37,41); direction words were read across line breaks and the line_no given is the line carrying the food name. FLAGS: (1) りんご/柿 (L25) are stated only negatively as 「体を冷やさない果物」 — no 陽性/温める label. Coded warm because the whole passage is a binary 陰性/陽性 contrast list, but this is the weakest attribution on the page and could defensibly be left uncoded or read as 中庸. (2) 柿 warm (L25) vs 干し柿 cool (L25) is an explicit state split stated by the source, not a contradiction. (3) じゃがいも appears twice, both cool: L27 hiragana 「じゃがいもは陰性です」 and L40 katakana 「陰性のジャガイモですが」 — coded once at L27; the katakana form ジャガイモ is also verbatim present at L40. (4) 化学調味料 appears twice, both cool (L43 極陰性, L52). (5) 食品添加物/白いお砂糖/化学調味料 are coded cool, but note the source itself introduces them with 「一番体を冷やすのは食品そのものではありません」 i.e. it frames them as non-foods; 白砂糖 (L52) is a second verbatim form of 白いお砂糖. NOT CODED: 電磁波 (L53, described as 体を冷やす but not a food); 温野菜 (L44, 「温野菜にすれば大丈夫」 — no direction word, only 大丈夫); きゅうり and 夏野菜 (L87, mentioned with no direction attached); 果物 (L22, only 「スイカやなしなどの果物」 = exemplification, the umbrella is not given a direction); cooking methods given directions but not foods — 煮る/焼く/干す/熟成 →陽性 (L31-32), 黒焼き (L35), 揚げ物 (L39); 玄米 at L77/L79-80 (life-force prose, no direction — its 中庸 coding comes from L28); 小魚 (L81, no direction). No serving-temperature items (「冷たい飲み物」type) occur anywhere on this page.
